    • PHANTOM_FILE_FLAG

      static final int PHANTOM_FILE_FLAG
      Indicates if the file should be ignored. It was present to allow file communication programs to have custom data sent in the file. Non-zero indicates a regular file.
      See Also:

    • DATA_FLAGS

      static final int DATA_FLAGS

      Metadata on the contents.

      Bit Description
      7 1 = file is compressed
      6 1 = file is encrypted
      5..1 reserved
      0 1 = file is sparse
